    About this item

    • Instant Brightening Effect – Infused with Glutathione, this polish helps brighten the skin from within, giving you a radiant and even-toned complexion.
    • Powered by Kojic Acid, it effectively fades stubborn tan, leaving your skin visibly brighter.
    • Tan Removal Made Easy – Eliminates stubborn sun damage and dullness
    • Easy Wipe-Off Formula – gently exfoliates dead skin cells, instantly revealing fresher, smoother skin without the need for harsh scrubbing.
    • Smooth & Even Texture – It delivers an instant glow and polished finish, making your skin look luminous and revitalized after just one use.
    • With its non-abrasive and nourishing formula, it’s safe and gentle enough for regular use.

      Important information

      Safety Information:

      For external use only

      Directions:

      1.Perform a patch test to check for any sensitivity - Follow the instructions exactly. Irritation or allergic reaction may occur with some people, even after prior use without adverse effects. Therefore, a test should always be carried out on a small part of the area to be treated before each use. Follow instructions as mentioned under HOW TO USE, but only for a small area on the inner side of the elbow and if the skin appears normal after 24 hours, proceed with full application. Discontinue use if any irritation appears on the skin. Consult a doctor if you experience unexpected skin reactions after use. 2. Measure & Mix - Use the bowl and measuring spoon provided. - The bigger side of the spoon is marked for lotion, and the smaller side is marked for powder. Put only 1 full scoop of lotion using the bigger side of the spoon and 1 full scoop of powder using the smaller side of the spoon in the bowl. - Always prepare only one portion per application using the provided bowl to maintain accurate measurement and optimal mixing. Never mix more than one otherwise it will not mix properly, and it will lead to side effects. - Mix vigorously for 2 minutes continue mixing even when the mixture turns pink, until the consistency is smooth and lump-free forming a fluffy-cream like texture. This step is mandatory to prevent skin irritation. - If you experience irritation or redness, apply ice immediately, if it doesn’t subside within 2 hours, consult a doctor. This happens due to improper mixing; make sure to mix thoroughly for 2 minutes until no pink particles remain. - Important: If a larger quantity is mixed and not blended properly, it may cause itchiness or skin reactions. - Mix thoroughly until you get a smooth, lump-free paste. - Ensure proper measurement and thorough mixing before application. - Mixture should be applied immediately after mixing. 3. Prep Your Skin - Apply Niconi Tan Vanish Pre & Post Polish Cream on the desired area before application. 4. Apply Evenly - Spread an even thick layer of the mixture over the desired area. 5. Watch for Color Change - The formula is pH-activated and changes from pink to white when ready. - The activation time varies from 10 to 20 minutes based on your skin type. - Do not exceed 25 minutes. - Slight tingling sensation is normal. 6. Rinse & Moisturize - Wash off with water and gently wipe clean. - Apply Niconi Tan Vanish Pre & Post Polish Cream for a nourished, glowing finish. Note that: If you notice dark spots after use, it means the top tan layer has been removed and your natural skin with existing pigmentation is now visible. DOs:1. Patch Test : Follow the instructions exactly. Irritation or allergic reaction may occur with some people, even after prior use without adverse effects. Therefore, a test should always be carried out on a small part of the area to be treated before each use. Follow instructions as mentioned under HOW TO USE, but only for a small area on the inner side of the elbow and if the skin appears normal after 24 hours, proceed with full application. Discontinue use if any irritation appears on the skin. Consult a doctor if you experience unexpected skin reactions after use. 2. When mixing lotion and powder together, mix vigorously for 2 minutes to avoid the risk of skin irritation. If any pink particles are visible in the mixture, it indicates incomplete blending. Refer to the "How to Use: Measure and Mix" section for proper mixing instructions. 3. Start with Clean Skin – Wash your face/hand/body and ensure it is free from makeup, oils, or lotions for the best results. 4. Apply Evenly – Spread a thick, even layer to ensure even results. 5. Use a Timer – Follow the recommended time (10–20 mins) and remove once the color changes from pink to white. 6. Moisturize Before & After – Using the Niconi Tan Vanish Pre & Post Polish Cream before application and after rinsing is necessary for hydrated, nourished skin. 7. Wear Sunscreen – Your skin may be more sensitive post-treatment; always apply SPF before sun exposure. 8. Limit Use – Use only once every 15 days as the the product is very potent. 9. Pregnant or Lactating Mothers should consult their doctors before using this product. 10. In case of eye contact, rinse immediately with water. 11. Keep out of reach of children. 12. If irritation occurs, wash off immediately and discontinue use.DON’Ts: 1. Do Not Apply on Beard, Eyebrows or Hairline – The mixture may alter hair color if it comes in contact. 2. Do Not Use on Broken, Irritated, or Acne-Prone Skin – Avoid applying to cuts, wounds, active acne, or sensitive areas to prevent irritation. 3. Avoid contact with clothes as the formula may alter fabric color or cause stains. 4. Keep Away from Eyes, Lips & Open Wounds – These areas are highly sensitive and should be avoided. 5. Do not apply on private parts as there is no tanning in those areas. Private parts are naturally dark. 6. Do not use on kids, as they have growing skin. (Try to use Milk, Besan, Malai, Haldi and other such home remedies first) 7. Avoid Post-Waxing or Threading – Wait at least 24–48 hours before use to prevent sensitivity. 8. Do Not Exceed the Recommended Time – Leaving it on for too long can cause redness or irritation. 9. Avoid Sun Exposure Immediately After – Your skin may be more prone to pigmentation; minimize direct sunlight exposure. 10. Do Not Use Harsh Scrubs or Actives Right After – Allow your skin to recover before using exfoliants or chemical treatments. 11. Tie Your Hair Back – Wear a headband to keep hair away and prevent accidental lightening. By following these guidelines, you can ensure a safe, effective, and irritation-free experience with Tan Vanish Niconi Gluta-Kojic Skin Polish! Disclosure: 1. DO NOT APPLY ON Beard, Eyebrows & Moustache. 2. 2 MIN MIXING powder and lotion IS COMPULSORY. 3. Contains lightening agents like glutathione, kojic acid, sodium persulfate, arbutin and hydrogen peroxide which may turn the hair golden while removing the tan. Caution : This product is specially formulated for tan removal and is not intended to lighten or alter the natural skin tone. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, lips, and sensitive areas. Do not apply on broken, irritated, or sunburned skin. A patch test is advised 24 hours prior to use to check for sensitivity. Slight tingeling sensation on using is normal. Discontinue use if irritation or redness occurs, and consult a dermatologist if needed. Use only as directed. This product may increase sensitivity to sunlight; apply sunscreen and limit sun exposure during and after use. Not recommended for children under 15 years of age. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and out of reach of children. Individual results may vary. Use only as directed. Only one unit of the measured product should be mixed at a time. Do not combine multiple doses in a single preparation. The manufacturer cannot be held responsible for effects resulting from incorrect application or failure to follow usage guidelines.

          About this Item

          • Instant Brightening Effect – Infused with Glutathione, this polish helps brighten the skin from within, giving you a radiant and even-toned complexion.
          • Powered by Kojic Acid, it effectively fades stubborn tan, leaving your skin visibly brighter.
          • Tan Removal Made Easy – Eliminates stubborn sun damage and dullness
          • Easy Wipe-Off Formula – gently exfoliates dead skin cells, instantly revealing fresher, smoother skin without the need for harsh scrubbing.
          • Smooth & Even Texture – It delivers an instant glow and polished finish, making your skin look luminous and revitalized after just one use.
          • With its non-abrasive and nourishing formula, it’s safe and gentle enough for regular use.

          Product description

          Struggling with dull skin, tanning, or uneven complexion? Niconi Gluta Kojic Skin Polish is your ultimate skincare solution for tan removal and deep exfoliation. Powered by Glutathione and Kojic Acid, this skin polish targets dark spots, uneven skin tone, and dullness with visible results from the very first use. The advanced kojic care formula gently removes dead skin cells, revealing fresh, smooth, and glowing skin beneath. Infused with the brightening power of gulta and the skin-refining properties of kojic acid, this skin polish works wonders in reducing pigmentation and restoring your natural skin glow. Whether you're dealing with daily sun exposure or stubborn tan removal concerns, this powerful blend delivers bright, even-tone without harsh scrubbing. Detan without the struggle! DOs: 1. Patch Test : Follow the instructions exactly. Irritation or allergic reaction may occur with some people, even after prior use without adverse effects. Therefore, a test should always be carried out on a small part of the area to be treated before each use. Follow instructions as mentioned under HOW TO USE, but only for a small area on the inner side of the elbow and if the skin appears normal after 24 hours, proceed with full application. Discontinue use if any irritation appears on the skin. Consult a doctor if you experience unexpected skin reactions after use. 2. When mixing lotion and powder together, mix vigorously for 2 minutes to avoid the risk of skin irritation. If any pink particles are visible in the mixture, it indicates incomplete blending. Refer to the "How to Use: Measure and Mix" section for proper mixing instructions. 3. Start with Clean Skin – Wash your face/hand/body and ensure it is free from makeup, oils, or lotions for the best results. 4. Apply Evenly – Spread a thick, even layer to ensure even results. 5. Use a Timer – Follow the recommended time (10–20 mins) and remove once the color changes from pink to white. 6. Moisturize Before & After – Using the Niconi Tan Vanish Pre & Post Polish Cream before application and after rinsing is necessary for hydrated, nourished skin. 7. Wear Sunscreen – Your skin may be more sensitive post-treatment; always apply SPF before sun exposure. 8. Limit Use – Use only once every 15 days as the the product is very potent. 9. Pregnant or Lactating Mothers should consult their doctors before using this product. 10. In case of eye contact, rinse immediately with water. 11. Keep out of reach of children. 12. If irritation occurs, wash off immediately and discontinue use. DON’Ts: 1. Do Not Apply on Beard, Eyebrows or Hairline – The mixture may alter hair color if it comes in contact. 2. Do Not Use on Broken, Irritated, or Acne-Prone Skin – Avoid applying to cuts, wounds, active acne, or sensitive areas to prevent irritation. 3. Avoid contact with clothes as the formula may alter fabric color or cause stains. 4. Keep Away from Eyes, Lips & Open Wounds – These areas are highly sensitive and should be avoided. 5. Do not apply on private parts as there is no tanning in those areas. Private parts are naturally dark. 6. Do not use on kids, as they have growing skin. (Try to use Milk, Besan, Malai, Haldi and other such home remedies first) 7. Avoid Post-Waxing or Threading – Wait at least 24–48 hours before use to prevent sensitivity. 8. Do Not Exceed the Recommended Time – Leaving it on for too long can cause redness or irritation. 9. Avoid Sun Exposure Immediately After – Your skin may be more prone to pigmentation; minimize direct sunlight exposure. 10. Do Not Use Harsh Scrubs or Actives Right After – Allow your skin to recover before using exfoliants or chemical treatments. 11. Tie Your Hair Back – Wear a headband to keep hair away and prevent accidental lightening. By following these guidelines, you can ensure a safe, effective, and irritation-free experience with Tan Vanish Niconi Gluta-Kojic Skin Polish! How To Use: 1. Perform a patch test to check for any sensitivity (Refer to Do’s for How to do so) 2. Measure & Mix - Use the bowl and measuring spoon provided. - The bigger side of the spoon is marked for lotion, and the smaller side is marked for powder. Put only 1 full scoop of lotion using the bigger side of the spoon and 1 full scoop of powder using the smaller side of the spoon in the bowl. - Always prepare only one portion per application using the provided bowl to maintain accurate measurement and optimal mixing. Never mix more than one otherwise it will not mix properly, and it will lead to side effects. - Mix vigorously for 2 minutes continue mixing even when the mixture turns pink, until the consistency is smooth and lump-free forming a fluffy-cream like texture. This step is mandatory to prevent skin irritation. - If you experience irritation or redness, apply ice immediately, if it doesn’t subside within 2 hours, consult a doctor. This happens due to improper mixing; make sure to mix thoroughly for 2 minutes until no pink particles remain. - Important: If a larger quantity is mixed and not blended properly, it may cause itchiness or skin reactions. - Mix thoroughly until you get a smooth, lump-free paste. - Ensure proper measurement and thorough mixing before application. - Mixture should be applied immediately after mixing. 3. Prep Your Skin - Apply Niconi Tan Vanish Pre & Post Polish Cream on the desired area before application. 4. Apply Evenly - Spread an even thick layer of the mixture over the desired area. 5. Watch for Color Change - The formula is pH-activated and changes from pink to white when ready. - The activation time varies from 10 to 20 minutes based on your skin type. - Do not exceed 25 minutes. - Slight tingling sensation is normal. 6. Rinse & Moisturize - Wash off with water and gently wipe clean. - Apply Niconi Tan Vanish Pre & Post Polish Cream for a nourished, glowing finish. Note that: If you notice dark spots after use, it means the top tan layer has been removed and your natural skin with existing pigmentation is now visible. Disclosure: 1. DO NOT APPLY ON Beard, Eyebrows & Moustache. 2. 2 MIN MIXING powder and lotion IS COMPULSORY. 3. Contains lightening agents like glutathione, kojic acid, sodium persulfate, arbutin and hydrogen peroxide which may turn the hair golden while removing the tan. Caution : This product is specially formulated for tan removal and is not intended to lighten or alter the natural skin tone. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, lips, and sensitive areas. Do not apply on broken, irritated, or sunburned skin. A patch test is advised 24 hours prior to use to check for sensitivity. Slight tingeling sensation on using is normal. Discontinue use if irritation or redness occurs, and consult a dermatologist if needed. Use only as directed. This product may increase sensitivity to sunlight; apply sunscreen and limit sun exposure during and after use. Not recommended for children under 15 years of age. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and out of reach of children. Individual results may vary. Use only as directed. Only one unit of the measured product should be mixed at a time. Do not combine multiple doses in a single preparation. The manufacturer cannot be held responsible for effects resulting from incorrect application or failure to follow usage guidelines.
